verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an Experimentation feature with a Bayesian statistics engine for reading A/B test results (flagsmith-docs-7/25/35/38), and separately an official MCP server plus Admin API giving agents programmatic access to flags/segments/environments (flagsmith-docs-17/29, probe-3, probe-rt-1). However, no evidence confirms the MCP/Admin API surface exposes the experiment analytics/results data (vs. just flag/segment CRUD), so an agent's ability to programmatically pull experiment outcomes (not just configs) for ship/rollback recommendations is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP endpoint for reading experiment statistics results, and any example of an agent consuming that data to produce a recommendation.
